_comment: Hand-curated expected verdicts for RL-style calibration. Verdicts are price-conditional — a WATCHLIST near the buyBelow price is essentially correct. Use marginPct to define the 'close enough' zone.

_schema.verdict: Expected verdict when price is at or below buyBelow (BUY/WATCHLIST/FAIL)
_schema.buyBelow: User's buy price target in USD — BUY signal at or below this price
_schema.marginPct: How close to buyBelow counts as 'close enough' (default 10%). WATCHLIST within this margin = acceptable.
_schema.source: How the user arrived at this verdict

LULU.source: User Rule One analysis — MOS/PBT/TenCap/EquityBond convergence
